html:
Hanoi to Moc Chau by private car is such a comfortable and flexible door-to-door transfer service to travel to Moc Chau with our experienced driver.

The distance between Hanoi and Moc Chau is approximately 180 kilometers (112 miles), and the driving time can vary depending on road conditions and traffic, but it typically takes around 4-5 hours to reach Moc Chau by car.

Traveling from Hanoi to Moc Chau by private car is a convenient and comfortable way to explore this scenic region in Vietnam. Moc Chau is known for its beautiful landscapes, tea plantations, and flower gardens, making it a popular destination for nature lovers.

HANOI TO MOC CHAU BY PRIVATE CAR

To meet all the different requests from our valued customers, Vietlook Travel creates some travel options such as

Option 1: Hanoi Airport to Moc Chau Transfer

By booking the private car from Hanoi Airport to Moc Chau, please provide us with your flight number/ landing time and the number of people. Our Hanoi private car and driver will be ready at the Noi Bai Airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can easily recognize him.

After greetings and helping you to set up the luggage, we start the Hanoi to Moc Chau private car transfer. The direct transfer from Hanoi to Moc Chau takes about 5 hours and if you have a lot of time, you can request our driver to stop at convenient places for you to capture photos, take a break, and drink some coffee.

Upon arrival at Moc Chau Hotel, our experienced driver will double-check the private car to make sure you don’t forget anything before saying goodbye to you.

Option 2: Hanoi Hotel to Moc Chau Private Car

With this travel option, you can choose your pickup time and our driver will be ready at your hotel lobby following your request. After greetings and reminding you not to forget the passports, we start the private car Hanoi to Moc Chau transfer.

Along the way, our friendly driver will stop at places for you to go to the toilets, have lunch, or take a short break. Upon arrival at your hotel in Moc Chau downtown, he will drop you off and make sure you forget nothing in the car.

We finish the Ha Noi to Moc Chau by private car and Vietlook Travel wishes you a wonderful transfer with us.

Mộc Châu is a refreshing mountain escape known for vast tea plantations, colorful flowers, and cool climate. Tourists can explore stunning waterfalls, hike Pha Luong Peak, and visit impressive caves. Rich ethnic cultures, traditional villages, and festivals add to the experience. The famous Bach Long Glass Bridge and eco-tourism spots offer unique adventures in nature.

Travel Thoughts:

  • Vehicle Options: Private car services offer various vehicle options to suit your needs and group size. You can typically choose from sedans, SUVs, vans, or even a minivan or VIP Limousine if you’re traveling with a group. The choice of vehicle will also affect the price.
  • Booking in Advance: It’s advisable to book your private car in advance, especially if you’re traveling during peak tourist seasons. This ensures that a vehicle and driver will be available on your preferred date and time.
  • Pickup and Drop-Off Locations: Specify your desired pickup location in Hanoi and your destination in Moc Chau when making the booking. Popular pickup points in Hanoi include the Old Quarter, Noi Bai International Airport, or your hotel.
  • Driver’s English: Our drivers can speak very basic English but our professional travel experts are always available via WhatsApp at (+84) 98.339.3488.
  • Cost: The cost of a private car from Ha Noi to Moc Chau can vary based on the type of vehicle you choose, the distance, and any additional services or stops you request. Our travel experts will tell you all the detailed information and prices before confirming your booking.
  • Comfort and Amenities: Our private car services often provide amenities such as air conditioning, comfortable seating, bottled water, tolls, parking fees, gasoline, and sometimes even Wi-Fi.
